digest_basis: sha256 over the bytes on disk. figures/.gitattributes pins LF for every extension listed here -- run artefacts (*.json/*.log/*.txt/*.jsonl) and the attributes file itself were added in this item -- so these are the bytes a clone gets. The generator asserts no CRLF rather than trusting it.
utc_correction: The first version of this manifest, and this directory's original name, said 16:00:00Z. That was the local clock (+0800) written into a field that means UTC; the work actually ran about 10:45-11:00Z. Corrected rather than left, because a provenance record whose timestamp is five hours out is worse than no timestamp -- it looks authoritative. Recorded because the same error was made independently in this session's heartbeats on the same day.
what: two fixes: fig06 EXPECTED_IDS derived from the declared source; a figure-citation gate that enumerates build_all.FIGURES instead of hard-coding three
